command_namespace._comment: Sandwich Namespacing Layer 2 — manifest-declared namespace prefix for plugin commands. Forward-compat: if host runtime supports `command_namespace` declaration, commands surface as /maos:<name> (preventing cross-plugin collision). If host does not support, fallback to function-specific filename (Layer 3) handles disambiguation. See AGENTS.md §34 and sister-PR ekson73/vek-dot-claude#54 (vendor-reserved-words audit list, Layer 4).

vendor_reserved_audit._comment: Sandwich Namespacing Layer 4 reference — list of vendor-native command names plugins should NEVER override at filename level.
